Gauge.Name: Replacement Animations for launch bar and tailhook
Gauge.Comment: This code serves to replace default launch bar and tailhook animations as they are not currently working in the sim. Variables employed are as follows: L:CarrierFunctionsEnabled, bool - TRUE if a non-zero value on SDK variables is detected L:switch_launch_bar_position, bool - Drives animation of the switch in the VC, TRUE is extend L:switch_launch_bar, bool - Commanded position of the launch bar, TRUE is extend, FALSE is retract L:launch_bar_animation, number - Drives animation of the launch bar in the model, 0 is retracted, 100 is extended L:launch_bar_status, number - Bespoke animation for the launch bar, 0 is retracted, 1 is extended L:lever_tailhook, bool L:tailhook_animation, number L:tailhook_status, number

LAUNCH VELOCITY CALCULATION - weight excess is calculated, multiplied by a coefficient and added to the base weight - then 1.7 (roughly) converts knots to feet per second - launchSpeed is calculated in feet per second

Select.Value: (A:SIM ON GROUND, bool) ! (L:tailhook_animation, number) 2 < or (A:RADIO HEIGHT, feet) 9.99 > or (A:PLANE ALTITUDE,feet) 50 < (A:PLANE ALTITUDE,feet) 100 > or or if{ 0 (>L:CarrierRecovery, bool) }
(A:SIM ON GROUND, bool) ! (L:launch_bar_animation, number) 10 < or (A:RADIO HEIGHT, feet) 9.99 > or (A:PLANE ALTITUDE,feet) 50 < (A:PLANE ALTITUDE,feet) 100 > and or if{ 0 (>L:CatapultLaunch, bool) }
